column1: Model-based estimates of unemployment for local authorities1
1. The figures are based on a model which utilises Annual Population Survey estimates of unemployment along with the Claimant Count averaged over 12 months. A user guide provides further information.

2. These figures represent '95% confidence intervals'. If a large number of samples were taken, and a 95% confidence interval was calculated for each sample, it is expected that in 95% of samples the range would contain the true value.
Estimates of unemployment rates help in monitoring progress towards global indicator 8.5.2 of the UN's Sustainable Development Goals
